gallery.filename: The student sprayers keeping medics safe from Ebola in Makeni, Sierra Leone (16341476412).jpg
gallery.title: File:The student sprayers keeping medics safe from Ebola in Makeni, Sierra Leone (16341476412).jpg
gallery.artist: DFID - UK Department for International Development
gallery.description:
Lamin Koroma and Suley Kamara were both at university before joining the team at the British-built Makeni Ebola treatment centre.
The pair play a vital role in keeping the medics at Makeni safe as they exit from the wards - spraying them down with chlorine to kill the virus and helping to guide them through the careful removal of their safety suits.
Meet more of the hidden heroes helping to defeat the disease in Sierra Leone at: bit.ly/ebolaheroes

gallery.filename: Laundry that helps to saves lives in the fight against Ebola (16154988230).jpg
gallery.title: File:Laundry that helps to saves lives in the fight against Ebola (16154988230).jpg
gallery.artist: DFID - UK Department for International Development
gallery.description:
Isatu Jalloh and Adama Samura are just two of the hidden heroes helping to beat the disease at the Makeni Ebola treatment centre - run by International Medical Corps and supported by UK aid.
They keep on top of the laundry, washing nurses' and doctors' scrubs so that they in turn can keep focussed on the life-saving medical care.
Meet more of the hidden heroes helping to defeat the disease in Sierra Leone at: bit.ly/ebolaheroes
